name: The Harlequin
summary: One of the six Wayward Haints of the Ghostlight Express.

stages.journal: A jester on a trapeze in the Circus Car, who wants to be certain that the tiger she let out of its cage cannot hurt anyone again. The tiger is asleep in the Baggage Car.
stages.hint: The trapeze in the Circus Car. Talk to them, or ask the Vagrant through a grille.

stages.journal: We brought her the iron ring off the tiger's tail. She took a real bow.
We told her enough of the truth that she let it go.
We corked her in a jar, bells and all.

stages.hint: Fight it, or leave the car; it will not follow.

stages.journal: We put her down. The trapeze keeps swinging.
